name: Set
description: Create or overwrite data fields manually.

properties.name: overwrite
properties.description: If enabled, only the fields defined here will be in the output. If disabled, fields are added to the existing data.

properties.name: values
properties.description: Define the fields you want to set. Use {{data.field}} to reference input data.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Name of the field to set (supports dot notation like 'user.name')

fields.name: value
fields.description: Value to set. Can use {{data.field}} to reference input data
